title: Enlightened Science
summary: What the Technocratic Union says its name means.

claims.text: Techno stands for tools and rational planning, cratic for a meritocracy of scientific skill, and Union for a body that includes every person on Earth.
Those who grasp science best are held to lead and guard those who can only use its fruits.
Inspired Science, reaching past known facts to new principles, is what sets a Technocrat apart from the Masses.
Front-Line staff often include citizens capable of only minor Procedures; overeager ones are mocked as proles.
New Enlightened agents include reconditioned Reality Deviants and willing recruits, and each team answers to a Supervisor chosen for the mission's field.
Each Convention has its own Supervisor titles, such as Programmers in Iteration X, Chairmen in the Syndicate and Commanders among Void Engineers.
The highest masters form the Inner Circle, and masters can watch their agents through Control, a group mind.

title: The Pogrom
summary: The policy that any mage outside the Union must die.

claims.text: For over a century a movement has pushed the Pogrom, holding that every mage not working for the Technocracy must be destroyed.
Not all Technocrats back it, but support swells whenever the supernatural grows overt or the Traditions score a big win.
In 1997 a cabal tried to bring down a Horizon Construct, setting off days of slaughter on the Front Lines.

title: Technocratic Conditioning
summary: The stages by which Control shapes a mind.

claims.text: Early stages instil rote phrases and make a subject accept minor Procedures from Control without resistance; a Procedure above two Sphere dots counts as major.
A conditioned mage may undergo a Seeking showing the Ascension it would reach by joining the Technocracy, a vision many find disturbing.
At the Suspicion stage Control can mark people as allies or enemies to be watched, and can plant code words.

title: NWO Operatives
summary: The covert arm of the Union in its older form.

claims.text: Men in Gray watch Reality Deviants, Men in Black kill them, and Men in White police the Union itself and are much feared.
Operatives also comb government and business records, and whatever the FBI or CIA learns soon reaches the NWO.
A secret World Advisory Council is rumoured to have agents seeded in global banking, the United Nations and leading national governments.

title: Genegineers in the 1990s
summary: The Progenitor Methodology that builds life from within.

claims.text: Genegineers were called Mutagenic Engineers until 1954.
Unlike the surgical FACADE Engineers, they can build creatures from scratch or change them from the inside, giving Progenitor Constructs whole custom ecologies.
Botched creations can die horribly soon after birth, and most constructs are treated as second-class citizens in the Union.
